lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Kiko, you got the physical receipt back from Jules?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Yes, Ma'am!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: It confirms the gasoline purchase charged to school maintenance.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Now integrate that proof directly into the whistleblower testimony.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Use the Office Computer to format the layout.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Center and bold the title, but here's the real test: watch your paragraph spacing.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Don't just hit Enter a bunch of times like an amateur. Put Space After on the testimony and the receipt, and Space Before on our conclusion.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Spacing gives each piece of evidence room to breathe. If you cram it all into one giant wall of text, Reyes will just skip it.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Make the truth easy to read. Make him see the story.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Are you done spacing out that evidence on the computer yet?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Space After on the proofs, Space Before on the conclusion. Don't let our evidence turn into a cluttered mess.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Let's see how you formatted the evidence document.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: [FEEDBACK]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Outstanding work, Editor-in-Chief.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The testimony and fuel receipt are clearly readable together.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Now we're ready for our final editorial stance.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We need the physical receipt before we can format the evidence board.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Be careful.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Mr. Reyes is inspecting the campus grounds today with the C.A.T. officers.
